description: This file defines the NotesFlow class, which orchestrates note CRUD operations, search, filtering, tagging, and bulk actions for a note-taking backend. It centralizes database interactions, handles note serialization to output models, and manages note-related business logic.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: A class that orchestrates all note operations including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, tagging, and listing with filters.

classes.name: NoteNotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a note with a specific ID does not exist.

methods.name: sqlite3.Row _get_note_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a note database row by ID; raises error if not found.

methods.name: List[str] _get_note_tags(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all tags associated with a given note.

methods.name: List[int] _ensure_tags(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, tags: List[str])
methods.description: Ensures tags exist in the database, creating them if necessary, and returns their IDs.

methods.name: None _replace_note_tags(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int, tags: List[str])
methods.description: Replaces all tags for a note with a new set of tags.

methods.name: NoteOut _row_to_note_out(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, row: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: Converts a database row to a NoteOut response model, including tags.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(self, payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional tags and returns the created note.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note(self, note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate)
methods.description: Partially updates a note's fields, tags included, and returns the updated note.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[int]] bulk_delete_notes(self, note_ids: List[int])
methods.description: Deletes multiple notes by IDs, returning lists of deleted and not found IDs.

methods.name: None _add_tags_to_notes(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_ids: List[int], tags: List[str])
methods.description: Internal helper to add tags to multiple notes without duplication.

methods.name: None _remove_tags_from_notes(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_ids: List[int], tags: List[str])
methods.description: Internal helper to remove tags from multiple notes.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[int]] bulk_add_tags(self, note_ids: List[int], tags: List[str])
methods.description: Adds tags to multiple notes, resolving tags and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[int]] bulk_remove_tags(self, note_ids: List[int], tags: List[str])
NoteListOut list_notes( self, q: Optional[str] = None, tag: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, starred: Optional[bool] = None, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0, )
methods.description: Lists notes with optional search, filtering by tags, starred status, and pagination.
